name: InlineEdit
usage: Renaming in lists and tables, editing quantities, prices and statuses in table cells, fields of a detail page

props.name: label
props.description:
Name of the field, such as "Name". Screen readers read the value button as "Edit Name" and the input as
"Name" (required: the value alone does not say what is edited).

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Text shown when the value is empty, also used as the placeholder of the input; "Not set" by default (follows
`locale`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables editing; the value stays readable.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Disabled reason: shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled`, such as "Only the owner can rename the
project". With a reason the value can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`) and screen readers read the
reason (as on Button).

props.name: onError
props.description:
Called when saving fails (`onSave` throws or its promise rejects). Return a user-readable text to show it below
the field instead of "Couldn't save. Try again." (never the raw exception). Without `onError` the error is
reported with `reportError`.

modes.title: Text (default)
modes.description: `value` is a string, and `onSave` receives the new text (`""` when the field is cleared).

props.name: type
props.description: Kind of field: `text`, `number` or `select`.

props.name: decimal
props.description: With `type="number"`: passes the value as a decimal string instead of a number.

props.name: value
props.description: The saved text; `null`, `undefined` and `""` are empty and show the placeholder.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Saves the new text (`""` when cleared); called only when it has changed and is valid. The new value is shown
right away (optimistic update). Return a promise to show the saving state: until it settles the field cannot
be edited again; if it rejects, the value rolls back and the field reopens with what was typed and an error
below it.

props.name: validate
props.description:
Validates the new text before saving: return an error text, or nothing when it is valid. Runs on `Enter` and
on blur; after an error, on every change, so the error disappears as soon as it is corrected.

props.name: render
props.description:
Renders a non-empty value in the display state, for example with a unit or as a Pill. By default the text is
shown.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum number of characters.

modes.title: Number: `type="number"`
modes.description:
For ordinary numbers such as counts: `value`, `min` and `max` are numbers, and `onSave` receives a number, or
`null` when the field is cleared. The number is shown localized.

props.name: type
props.description: Kind of field: `text`, `number` or `select`.

props.name: decimal
props.description:
Passes the value as a decimal string instead of a number, as InputNumber does. Use it for exact values such as
amounts: the value never goes through floating point.

props.name: value
props.description: The saved number; `null` and `undefined` are empty and show the placeholder.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Saves the new number, `null` when cleared; called only when it has changed and is valid. The new value is
shown right away (optimistic update); a returned promise works as with text.

props.name: validate
props.description:
Validates the new number before saving, after the range check: return an error text, or nothing when it is
valid.

props.name: render
props.description:
Renders a non-empty value in the display state, for example with a unit. By default the localized number is
shown.

props.name: precision
props.description:
Number of decimal places: the value is shown with exactly this many and rounded to it when saved. Without it,
the value is shown as it is.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest allowed value; smaller values show an error.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest allowed value; larger values show an error.

modes.title: Decimal string: `type="number"` with `decimal`
modes.description:
For exact values such as amounts and quantities: `value`, `min` and `max` are decimal strings such as
`"1250.50"`, `onSave` receives a decimal string (`null` when the field is cleared), and the value never goes
through floating point. The number is shown localized.

props.name: type
props.description: Kind of field: `text`, `number` or `select`.

props.name: decimal
props.description: Passes the value as a decimal string.

props.name: value
props.description:
The saved value as a decimal string, such as `"1250.50"`; `null`, `undefined` and `""` are empty and show the
placeholder.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Saves the new value as a decimal string, `null` when cleared; called only when it has changed and is valid
(`"1250.5"` and `"1250.50"` are the same value). The new value is shown right away (optimistic update); a
returned promise works as with text.

props.name: validate
props.description:
Validates the new value before saving, after the range check: return an error text, or nothing when it is
valid.

props.name: render
props.description:
Renders a non-empty value in the display state, for example with a currency. By default the localized number
is shown.

props.name: precision
props.description:
Number of decimal places: the value is shown with exactly this many and rounded to it when saved. Without it,
the value is shown as it is.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest allowed value, as a decimal string; smaller values show an error.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest allowed value, as a decimal string; larger values show an error.

modes.title: Choice: `type="select"`
modes.description: `value` is the value of one of the `options`; choosing an option saves it, and `onSave` receives its value.

props.name: type
props.description: Kind of field: `text`, `number` or `select`.

props.name: decimal
props.description: With `type="number"`: passes the value as a decimal string instead of a number.

props.name: options
props.description: The options; selecting one saves it.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the selected option; `null` and `undefined` are empty and show the placeholder.

props.name: onSave
props.description:
Saves the chosen option; called only when it differs from the current value. The new value is shown right away
(optimistic update); a returned promise works as with text.

props.name: validate
props.description: Validates the chosen option before saving: return an error text, or nothing when it is valid.

props.name: render
props.description:
Renders a non-empty value in the display state, for example as a Pill. By default the label of the option is
shown.

types.name: InlineEditOption<V>
types.summary: An option of an InlineEdit with `type="select"`.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value of the option, passed to `onSave` when it is chosen: a string or a number, such as an ID.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text of the option in the list; also what the display state shows for this value, unless `render` is given.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Click a value, or press `Enter` or `F2`, to edit it; `Enter` or moving focus away saves and `Esc` cancels. The
new value is shown right away while the promise returned by `onSave` is pending. `validate` runs before saving.

examples.name: InTable
examples.title: In a table
examples.description:
Edit cells in place: a text, numbers (localized, with `precision` and a range) and a status chosen from
`options`. Both states have the same height, so the rows do not move. The quantity is a number; the price is a
decimal string (`decimal`), so it never goes through floating point.

examples.name: States
examples.title: Failed saves and disabled fields
examples.description:
When saving fails, the value rolls back and the field reopens with what was typed and the text returned by
`onError` below it; press `Enter` to try again or `Esc` to cancel. A disabled field stays readable, and
`disabledReason` explains why it cannot be edited.
